fonts.display: 'Favorit', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Nunito Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Carbon Ink
palette.role: Primary text, filled action buttons, icon strokes, hairlines — the dominant ink across the entire interface

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark fills, image backgrounds

palette.name: Soft Mist
palette.role: Subtle surface alternation, disabled states, skeleton backgrounds, light dividers

palette.name: Warm Fog
palette.role: Off-white surface variant for subtle banding between product rows and editorial sections

palette.name: Blush Sand
palette.role: Warm cream surface for editorial highlight sections and seasonal accents

palette.name: Smoke Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary text, input borders, subdued UI chrome

palette.name: Onyx
palette.role: Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Stone Gray
palette.role: Placeholder backgrounds, image placeholder fills, neutral swatch defaults

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Cool charcoal for product photography backgrounds and muted editorial surfaces

palette.name: Olive Drab
palette.role: Warm muted surface for product photography contexts

palette.name: Maroon Clay
palette.role: Warm muted surface for product photography contexts

palette.name: Deep Iris
palette.role: Cool muted surface for product photography contexts

palette.name: Pewter
palette.role: Cool gray for product photography contexts

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Warm beige for product photography contexts

palette.name: Pale Tide
palette.role: Cool pastel surface for editorial accent sections
